import { defineAgent } from 'vite-hub/agent'
import { mcp } from 'vite-hub/agent/capabilities'
import { useChannel } from 'vite-hub/channels/server'
import { github } from 'vite-hub/workspace'
import bot from '../bot/agent'
import githubChannel from '../../channels/github'
import { portalMcpServers } from '../../mcp/servers'
import { githubSourceAuth } from '../../workspace/sources'
import { PRODUCTLANE_TEAMS_CHANNEL_ID } from '../../channels/teams/recipients'
import prefectChannel from '../../channels/prefect'
import productlaneChannel from '../../channels/productlane'
import { productlaneReadOnlyTools, productlaneTeamsDelivery, productlaneTeamsDrafting, productlaneTeamsFailure, productlaneTeamsMirror } from '../../channels/productlane/teams'
import instructions from './instructions.md?raw'

const teams = useChannel('teams')

export default defineAgent({
  name: 'bot-dev',
  extends: bot,
  driver: {
    instructions,
    requirements: inherited => [...inherited, 'env-cli', 'uv', 'kubectl', 'gcloud', 'helm', 'agent-browser'],
  },
  capabilities: [
    mcp({ servers: portalMcpServers }),
  ],
  messages: {
    timeout: 60 * 60 * 1000,
    consoleLink: true,
  },
  workspace: {
    store: { provider: 'local', locks: 'process' },
    materialize: 'none',
    sources: {
      portal: github({ auth: githubSourceAuth, cache: { maxAge: 3600 }, repo: 'example/portal' }),
    },
  },
  channels: {
    productlane: productlaneChannel({
      onMessage: productlaneTeamsMirror(teams, PRODUCTLANE_TEAMS_CHANNEL_ID),
      onDraft: productlaneTeamsDrafting(teams, PRODUCTLANE_TEAMS_CHANNEL_ID),
      onFailed: productlaneTeamsFailure(teams, PRODUCTLANE_TEAMS_CHANNEL_ID),
      capabilities: [productlaneReadOnlyTools, productlaneTeamsDelivery({
        channel: teams,
        recipient: PRODUCTLANE_TEAMS_CHANNEL_ID,
        description: 'Send the finished reply to its thread for internal review, or `NO_REPLY:` with a short note. Call this before finishing.',
      })],
    }),
    github: githubChannel(),
    prefect: prefectChannel(),
  },
})
